notes: Tier guide: tier 1 = fresh-context judge after step_3 (scope: full) or the conditional delta judge at step_4 (scope: delta, only when run-log marks substantive changes); tier 2 = peer judge at step_audit (scope: delta; its rules_audit is scoped to the judged artifact's step, derived from the artifact field, so the peer pass re-audits the letter's quote and measure rules). verdict: approved | needs-fixes. rules_audit (schema @3): one entry for EVERY quote or measure rule of the judged artifact's step — the `quote` and `measure` rows for that step in references/rule-digests.md (confirm rules are the writer's check files' job via check_rules.py --gate; they cannot be quoted or measured out of the artifact). Each entry: verdict pass|fail, evidence = what you checked; quote rules add a quote = a span copied verbatim from the judged artifact (verify_artifacts rejects paraphrase); measure rules state the measurement with its number in evidence (the gate requires the digit); a quote is optional there and, if added, must be verbatim. An approved report requires every rules_audit verdict pass. One exhaustive structured pass per run; re-judge rounds capped at 2, then escalate to the user. Every flagged item must be resolved before progress.py --approve accepts this report. Save as the gate's own file: review-report-step_3.json (tier 1, full), review-report-step_4.json (tier 1, delta), review-report-step_audit.json (tier 2, delta). Reports accumulate; every gate reads only its own file.
